name: meta_floor_sensitivity
what_this_is: a sensitivity of the 13-study heterogeneity verdict to the patient floor, where each floor is the smallest n at which a named moment of the inverse-variance weight exists
what_this_is_not: a threshold search, and not a licence to drop a study. The three floors are fixed by the chi-square df condition (E[w] finite iff n>=4, Var[w] finite iff n>=6) and were written down before the curve was run.
closed_form: E[w_hat]/w_true = (n-1)/(n-3); no finite mean at n<=3
does_not_touch: the adenoma results (avenue A, §6h, §6j) — they do not go through meta.py at all

verdict.detail: KRT8: heterogeneity_over_ceiling -> homogeneous_straddles_tolerance once studies whose weights are not integrable are excluded, and n>=4 and n>=6 agree. The verdict was carried by those studies. This says the instrument was unstable to a criterion nobody had applied; it does NOT say the controls hold. And the fixed 75% ceiling disagrees with its own calibrated null for KRT8 at one or more floors — the ceiling calls them homogeneous where the null does not.
